notes.title: Jun 27 - Massive Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
[p]As we're quickly approaching the point at which we'll announce the game the previous weeks has been focused on stabilizing the game both by reducing crashes and fixing the balance of the game. At this point crashes are very rare on our own machines so we would be VERY interested if you manage to hang the game. Please reach out either through the bug report form ([url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdMxn1Nn8O5-pZZQ02Kr0bYqCohawRsYh8W-AmvfiFJyjNwLg/viewform"]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdMxn1Nn8O5-pZZQ02Kr0bYqCohawRsYh8W-AmvfiFJyjNwLg/viewform[/url]) or directly to us.

We've also started a discord for people to talk about the game and gather everyone in one place. As of now it´s pretty barren but it´s on the TODO list to make something more of it. At some point we might give away keys to the full game (the current BETA keys won´t work after release) and we'll probably do that through the discord. If you get in early enough I'll probably promote everyone that was part of the Beta to some elevated role so if that interest you make sure that you join early enough!
